Question B-003-018-010.

Why the correct answer is right: Before checking a mains-operated supply, first turn it off and unplug it so live mains power is removed from the work.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "short out the leads of the filter capacitor": Do not start by shorting a capacitor in an energized or not-yet-isolated supply; after unplugging, use a controlled discharge method to avoid arcs, damage, and shock risk.
- sourceIndex 2: "check the action of the capacitor bleeder resistance": Bleeder resistors are checked only after the unit is made safe enough to work on; they are not the first step before unplugging.
- sourceIndex 3: "remove and check the fuse from the power supply": Pulling a fuse does not prove the unit is unplugged, and stored capacitor charge may remain after the fuse is removed.
